geometry_edits.rationale: Wrap the existing dominant mass in a courtyard/public-void logic so the ground plane becomes programmatically active.
Open the new public void toward the verified access side to make the frontage response explicit.
Keep the void proportion substantial enough to read as usable public space rather than a decorative cut.

graph_edits.rationale: Shift the primary from a neutral courtyard to a stronger carved mass that can generate a readable public threshold without losing the dominant bent-bar gesture.
Increase the depth of the subtraction so the ground response becomes a legible usable void rather than a shallow notch.
Align the void opening with the program access side to reinforce the public threshold on the street edge.

rationale: The candidate reads as one dominant bent bar/prismatic mass with a coherent silhouette across views, so it avoids the worst fragmentation and multi-view collision failure. The parcel response is acceptable in containment and orientation, but the public-space figure is weak: the blue frontage edge is acknowledged only indirectly, with no clear carved court, entry seam, or undercut that would make the ground edge legible. Programmatically it can still plausibly hold neighborhood living/commercial-mixed use because the volume is compact and capacity-aware, but the section is still too object-like and not yet strongly tuned to active frontage plus usable public void. The references support a disciplined singular mass and some stepped/tapered continuity, but the candidate currently underperforms on the required active street threshold.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Much taller and more tower-like than this neighborhood-living candidate; useful for silhouette discipline, not typology.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A single legible dominant prism with a stepped/tapered upper profile that keeps the mass readable in multiple views.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Office-tower scale and waterfront context are not transferable as a program model.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A coherent vertical mass can carry a subtle twist/torque without fragmenting the overall body.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: The actual building is far smaller and flatter; only the entry/ground response is relevant.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A modest ground-contact volume with a clear threshold can support neighborhood-scale public use.
